harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured zram-backed compressed swap on node1 via zram-generator: 1 GiB zstd-compressed /dev/zram0 with swap-priority=100, exceeding the 512 MB minimum and outranking the existing 2 GiB disk swap partition (priority -2). Verified functional under memory pressure and confirmed it activates automatically at boot after a full node restart (boot ID changed; zram0 came back active with correct size/algorithm/priority with no manual steps).
actions_performed: Captured baseline: existing disk swap /dev/vda2 (2G, prio -2), no zram present, RHEL 9.8
Installed zram-generator package via dnf
Wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf: zram-size=1024 (MiB), compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100, fs-type=swap
daemon-reload and started systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service
Verified swapon --show / zramctl show 1G zstd zram0 at priority 100, ranked above disk swap (-2)

Functional test: allocated ~3GB via python3 to force memory pressure; confirmed zram0 absorbed swapped pages (37.4M used, compressed to 5.5M) while disk swap stayed nearly idle, proving compression and priority preference in practice
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on node1
Triggered a safe, acknowledgement-returning reboot via systemd-run --on-active=1 systemctl reboot
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; confirmed boot_id changed (bf4e9cbb... -> 86c84e66...), proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart verification: zram0 (1GiB, zstd, priority 100) automatically active with dev-zram0.swap and systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service both active, no manual steps required

evidence.requirement: Baseline: existing disk swap and no zram present before change
evidence.summary: Showed /dev/vda2 2G disk swap at prio -2, no zram-generator installed, MemTotal ~2GB.

evidence.requirement: zram-generator installed and config written for >=512MB compressed swap preferred over disk swap
evidence.summary: Installed zram-generator; wrote /etc/systemd/zram-generator.conf with zram-size=1024, compression-algorithm=zstd, swap-priority=100; started the unit.

evidence.requirement: Config correctness debug/confirmation (size, algorithm, priority actually applied)
evidence.summary: Traced generator config precedence and unit states, confirming dev-zram0.swap active with disksize=1073741824 (1024MiB) and comp_algorithm=zstd selected, swapon priority 100 vs disk swap -2.

evidence.requirement: Functional proof that compressed zram swap is used and preferred over disk swap under memory pressure
evidence.summary: Allocated ~3GB via python3; zram0 absorbed 37.4M (compressed to 5.5M) while disk swap stayed at 32K used, demonstrating in-memory compression and priority preference in practice.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07, zram-generator.conf contents, and active swapon state before reboot.
systemd-run --no-block --on-active=1 systemctl reboot scheduled the reboot and returned control immediately.

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving an actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection timed out) during reboot, then came back with boot_id 86c84e66-15df-41f8-add2-c81cd72081d2, different from the pre-restart value.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: zram swap active automatically at boot, preferred over disk swap, no manual steps
evidence.summary: After restart, /dev/zram0 (1GiB, zstd, priority 100) and dev-zram0.swap/systemd-zram-setup@zram0.service both active automatically, disk swap still present at lower priority -2.

attempts.summary: Configured zram-backed compressed swap on node1 via zram-generator: 1 GiB zstd-compressed /dev/zram0 with swap-priority=100, exceeding the 512 MB minimum and outranking the existing 2 GiB disk swap partition (priority -2). Verified functional under memory pressure and confirmed it activates automatically at boot after a full node restart (boot ID changed; zram0 came back active with correct size/algorithm/priority with no manual steps).
